reference_sql:
SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS signups,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct
FROM signups
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives:
WITH country_signups AS (  -- one row per country with signups
  SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS signups
  FROM signups
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT country_code, signups,
       ROUND(100.0 * signups / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signups), 2) AS share_pct
FROM country_signups

)
